# laravelforge_org_server_credential_lookup (Data Source)

Lists all Laravel Forge server credentials within an organization.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) Slug of the Forge organization whose server credentials to list.

### Read-Only

- `credentials` (Attributes List) Server credentials in the organization. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credentials))

<a id="nestedatt--credentials"></a>
### Nested Schema for `credentials`

Read-Only:

- `cloud_provider` (String) Provider the credential authenticates against, e.g. `Hetzner Cloud` (Forge API `provider`; renamed because `provider` is reserved in HCL).
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Numeric ID of the credential.
- `in_use` (Boolean) Whether the credential is currently in use by a server.
- `name` (String) Credential name.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
